name: all_line_high_intensity_equipment_inspection
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-86, from Run 45558738725: Daegu urban railway all-line inspection, Kyunghyang and Newsis): after a series of failures the operator inspects the equipment of every line.

candidates.title: Operator starts high-intensity inspection of all lines after failures
candidates.search_snippet: Operator starts high-intensity inspection of all lines after failures.
candidates.source_content: After a series of power and signal failures, the city railway operator has started a high-intensity inspection of the equipment and facilities of all its lines. Inspection teams are checking power supply, signalling, rolling stock and station equipment over two weeks. The operator said defects found will be repaired immediately.
